in_marathi.name: अतुल
in_marathi.long_meaning: अतुल हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name अतुल is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘अतुल’ meaning 'immeasurable', 'boundless', or 'incomparable'. This name is often associated with the divine deity, Lord Vishnu, who is known for his infinite qualities and the power to preserve the universe. The name अतुल is believed to bestow the bearer with the qualities of being vast, limitless, and unending.
